posts.name: mightyschoop
posts.cooked:
The 5 OblivAeon heroes, Stuntman, and Benchmark all have the same Nemesis symbol, which I assume is OblivAeon himself.

The four Void Guard heroes retain the Sentinels/LA Capitan symbol.

Luminary will have "devices" in his deck. I assume they will be targets.

Dark Watch Harpy references Control Tokens, which intrigues me. 

Akash'Thriya mentions "primordial seeds" and has a ton of hp. My guess is that these will be targets and the character card will be damaged if they are destroyed. 

Hard to  infer anything about LA comodora, Lifeline, Stuntman, or Benchmark from their powers, except Stuntman may have some way of triggering a power out of turn. 

Idealist mentions the keywords "figment" and "concept." This feels like a complicated deck, along the lines of Argent adept. 

Writhe has a "shadow cloak." What will it do?

posts.name: Trajector
posts.cooked:
My guess is that the Primordial Seeds work similarly to Ambuscade’s traps: when they get shuffled into the Environment deck and they come up to the top, or get played, things happen. Probably powerful things, because that might take a while. Here’s an extrapolation: I bet Akash’Thriya has some mechanism to cause a shuffle of the Environment deck.

Writhe I think will be really interesting. His very low health suggests that the Shadow Cloak does something to mitigate or redirect much of the damage that he would otherwise take. But the fact that his power is to go get the Cloak also suggests that the Cloak offers him offensive powers, because the base power is not useful when you already have the Shadow Cloak in play. What those offensive capabilities are…I’m really curious!

posts.name: metaphysician
posts.cooked:
Looking at Akash's deck again, Primordial Seeds can't be a means to get Primordial Limbs into play, ala Unity.  Her variant has her Primordial Seeds in play do damage, so they have to stay in play.

Also, I strongly suspect that Akash has some way, probably multiple ways, to shuffle or stack the environment deck.  Otherwise, if you have to put Seeds into the environment trash, it would take far too many turns for anything worthwhile to result ( waiting for the entire environment deck to cycle ).  Either the ability would be too weak for a base power, to the point of uselessness; or else the Seeds are so awesome  that a ten turn delay is "balanced", and the game completely breaks if you have any means to speed the process.  Either way, not good design.  So, she either has other ways to get Seeds into play, or she has ways to cycle/shuffle/stack the Environment deck.
